basic_details.job_title: DSWO Ramanathapuram Security Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Social Welfare Office Ramanathapuram (DSWO Ramanathapuram) has notified 1 vacancy for the Security post on a contract basis. Applications must be submitted by hand to the District Social Welfare Office, District Collectorate Campus, Ariyalur, on or before 26 October 2026. The engagement is on a consolidated pay basis of Rs. 12,000.
